**Invincible: Guarding the Globe** is an immersive idle squad RPG set in the dynamic Invincible universe, presenting a brand new story never before revealed in the comics or the Amazon Prime TV series. Experience engaging graphic multi-battle action combined with extensive character collection, strategic team management, and captivating idle gameplay enhanced by stunning super-powered visuals.
Step into the world of Invincible through the first mobile RPG adaptation closely tied to the highly acclaimed Amazon Prime Video show. Follow a complete original campaign as you join the elite Global Defense Agency (GDA) to uncover the secrets behind a deadly clone army—and an intriguing mystery involving stolen burger meat—alongside the agency’s head, Cecil Stedman.
---
## Character Collection and Development
Recruit a diverse roster of iconic characters from the Invincible comics and show, including fan favorites such as Invincible and Atom Eve, as well as formidable adversaries like the Flaxans and Mauler Twins. Progress your team by gaining battle experience, leveling up, and combining clones to elevate their rank and unlock new tiers of strength, power, and combat prowess.

Strategically assemble your squad and deploy them into fast-paced RPG battles filled with intense combat sequences. Each team member specializes in a unique role—Attacker, Defender, or Support—inviting tactical choices to match every encounter. Trigger powerful ultimate abilities to devastate your enemies and secure victory with spectacular effects and animations.

Enjoy seamless idle battles that progress even while you are away from the game, allowing you to accumulate valuable rewards effortlessly. Enhance your gameplay by sending your heroes on GDA Ops—secondary missions that operate simultaneously and provide additional challenges and prizes beyond the main storyline.

Join forces with friends and build powerful alliances to engage in cooperative battles. Collaborate strategically to combat waves of enemies such as Magmanites, Reanimen, and Flaxans, who appear through portals or from alternate dimensions, testing your team’s strength and coordination.

Discover unique artifacts that offer additional stat bonuses and passive effects, with items available in varying rarity levels. Upgrade your gear to maximize its benefits and prepare your heroes for the toughest battles.

Stay engaged with daily and weekly missions that offer generous rewards to continually strengthen your team. Participate in frequent special events and offers designed to keep gameplay fresh and exciting. Each month introduces a new character from the Invincible universe, expanding your collection opportunities and game content.

apps.name: Apollo
apps.localizedDescription:
**Apollo** was a beloved iOS app designed for an exceptional Reddit browsing experience from 2015 through 2023. Over nearly a decade, it earned immense appreciation and loyalty from the Reddit community, reflected by over 100,000 five-star ratings and numerous accolades. The app was known for its intuitive design, powerful functionality, and commitment to enhancing user interaction with Reddit content.
In 2023, significant changes to Reddit's API pricing policy dramatically altered the landscape for third-party developers. With a sudden shift from a free API to potentially millions of dollars in annual fees and only 30 days’ notice, Apollo’s continued operation became unsustainable. As a result, the app was gracefully retired after years of delivering an outstanding user experience.
---
## Current State of the Apollo App
Although no longer active for browsing Reddit, Apollo now serves as a commemorative platform celebrating its legacy and the incredible community that supported it. Upon opening the app, users are greeted with a heartfelt thank you message from the developer, Christian Selig, expressing deep gratitude for the support over the years.
The app includes a **Goodbye Apollo wallpaper pack** available for unlocking, offering unique visuals as a tribute to the app’s history. Users who had Apollo previously downloaded can export their data by simply shaking their device, preserving personal information and memories from their time using the app.
Additionally, all previous Apollo app icons have been automatically unlocked, allowing users to personalize their app experience with nostalgic designs. Beyond these features, the app functions as a central hub to stay updated about other projects and developments by Christian Selig.
---
## Why Apollo Was Special
**Intuitive User Interface:** Built specifically for iOS, Apollo delivered seamless navigation and smooth interactions optimized for iPhones and iPads.**Rich Feature Set:** Including customizable views, efficient content browsing, multi-account support, and comprehensive notification settings.**Community-Driven Development:** The app evolved continuously with user feedback, making it a trusted tool cherished by millions.**Legacy and Impact:** Apollo’s influence on Reddit app design and standards remains significant, inspiring other iOS developers.
---
## Thank You for Being Part of the Journey
The retirement of Apollo marks the end of an era, but the memories and impact it created endure. The developer remains committed to delivering quality experiences through future projects, and this app continues to connect users to those updates.
Thank you for the incredible journey, the support, and the community spirit that made Apollo more than just an app — a shared experience treasured by thousands worldwide.

Adding amenities such as vending machines, restaurants, parking lots, and swimming pools will attract more guests and increase your earnings. However, each facility requires dedicated staff, so be sure to hire enough employees to maintain smooth operations and keep guests satisfied.

Collect vehicles, deliver cargo, complete contracts, and master city building to become the ultimate transport tycoon in a dynamic world full of diverse people and places. This free-to-play simulation lets you go beyond trains to master all modes of transport. Become the mayor of a small town and expand it into a thriving metropolis. Buy land, construct buildings, upgrade roads, and develop public transport infrastructure to boost your city’s growth.
Decorate your city, upgrade your company headquarters, and expand your train station to accommodate growing demand. Build factories to process the goods you acquire and dispatch your fleet across the world. This game offers a rich mix of transport-related simulations, combining elements of ship tycoon, railroad tycoon, plane tycoon, and city builder. Explore a detailed map filled with fascinating locations as you develop a complex transport network.

apps.localizedDescription:
**Uncover the mysteries of live air traffic** with Plane Finder, a beautiful and easy-to-use app designed exclusively for iOS. Whether you're a casual observer or an aviation enthusiast, Plane Finder allows you to identify any plane in the sky and access detailed live flight information instantly.
Plane Finder offers intuitive real-time tracking of almost any aircraft, providing you with its current location, altitude, speed, and heading. Experience the thrill of watching air traffic patterns unfold before your eyes on an interactive map, perfect for travelers, hobbyists, and professionals alike.
The app's functionality extends beyond simple tracking. You can receive alerts when a particular flight is approaching your location, making it easy to spot rare or special aircraft, such as the iconic Airbus A380. Additionally, you can switch seamlessly to an incredible 3D flight tracking mode from any aircraft, airport, or map location — transforming your viewing experience and offering a unique perspective of the skies.
**Plane Finder’s augmented reality (AR) mode** lets you point your iPhone camera at the sky and instantly view detailed live information about planes overhead. Designed with full support for iOS’s Dark Mode, the app is perfectly suited for both daytime and nighttime use, providing a stunning interface that is easy on the eyes while maintaining excellent readability.
---
## Key Features
**Live Global Flight Tracking**: Track flights worldwide in real time with accurate status updates displayed on a detailed map.**3D Flight Tracking**: Instantly switch to immersive 3D views for any aircraft or location to see flights like never before.**Live AR Mode**: Use augmented reality to identify aircraft by pointing your device to the sky, revealing live flight and technical data.**Extensive Airport Information**: Access live arrival and departure boards, terminal details, gate and baggage info, plus real-time weather conditions at hundreds of airports.**Comprehensive Technical Data**: Dive into in-depth technical details about aircraft and flights, enriching your experience and knowledge.**Customizable Alerts**: Create unlimited notifications for your favorite flights or aircraft to never miss an important event.**Unlimited Global Playback**: Replay flights and explore fascinating historical air traffic data dating back to 2011.**Powerful Filters**: Simplify your view by applying filters to focus on specific airlines, aircraft types, routes, and more.**Custom Aircraft Labels**: Personalize the look of aircraft labels on the map, including positioning, color, and content.**Advanced Dark Mode**: Enjoy a sleek, bold interface optimized for low-light environments, reducing eye strain during night flights.**Curated Map Styles**: Choose from simple, detailed, hybrid, or satellite maps to suit your preference and enhance your tracking sessions.## About Plane Finder
Highly praised since 2009, Plane Finder was featured by Apple in the “The Power of Dark Mode” and “See it in Dark Mode” collections in 2019, and recognized as Apple’s App of the Day in January 2020. The app has earned admiration from major media outlets and is trusted by families, aviation professionals, pilots, and cabin crew globally.
The technology behind Plane Finder uses real-time ADS-B and MLAT signals transmitted by aircraft and received by land-based stations for fast and precise tracking. This modern system provides faster updates than traditional radar and is employed for air traffic control purposes.
Plane Finder is regularly updated with innovative new features to ensure the best user experience. For any questions or assistance, our dedicated support team is available to help.
*Note: The data provided by Plane Finder is intended solely for entertainment and enthusiast use. It should not be relied upon for any activity that might jeopardize your safety or that of others.*

Download now and prove your worth as the sharpest shooter and most cunning strategist.

Unlock the true potential of your WhatsApp status with **PureStatus HD Status Compressor**. Start sharing your videos in high definition and impress your friends and followers with unmatched visual clarity.

Download Lumber Inc today and begin carving out your own path to success in the timber industry!

apps.name: RISE: Sleep Tracker
apps.localizedDescription:
**Join over 10 million users** and transform your sleep and energy with RISE, the ultimate sleep tracker backed by 100 years of sleep science. Unlike traditional sleep apps, RISE not only monitors your sleep patterns but also measures your **sleep debt** and energy levels to help you truly understand and improve your rest and daytime performance.
Trusted and recommended by the Sleep Foundation as well as professional teams in the NFL, MLB, NBA, and leading Fortune 500 companies, RISE delivers personalized insights and actionable advice that make better sleep achievable for everyone.
---
## Unlock Better Sleep with Sleep Debt Awareness
Forget the generic "eight hours of sleep" rule. RISE introduces you to the concept of **Sleep Debt**, a scientifically proven key factor affecting your wellbeing. High Sleep Debt leads to fatigue and health risks, while maintaining a low Sleep Debt can improve your quality of life and longevity. RISE calculates your Sleep Debt daily, explains how it impacts your energy, and guides you on reducing it through better sleep habits, including knowing your melatonin window and ideal times for naps.
## Personalized Sleep Tracking & Guidance
Do you struggle to fall asleep or wake up feeling groggy? RISE combines your sleep data, circadian rhythm insights, and research to offer tailored recommendations. The app helps you get to bed on time, manage wake-ups during the night, and reduce morning fatigue through easy-to-follow strategies crafted just for you.
## Discover and Optimize Your Circadian Rhythm
Your body's internal clock, or circadian rhythm, dictates your best times for alertness and rest. RISE uses advanced algorithms to analyze your unique rhythm and identify optimal sleep windows. This helps you plan your day for maximum productivity and rest. Enjoy the benefits of aligning your lifestyle with your natural biological cycles—83% of RISE users report increased energy within a week.
## Automatic Sleep and Activity Tracking
RISE integrates seamlessly with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and other popular sleep trackers like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye. It automatically tracks your sleep duration, Sleep Debt, daily steps, and other activities influencing your rest, allowing you to get a comprehensive view of your overall sleep health without manual input.
## Comprehensive Features to Enhance Your Sleep
Widgets for quick access to your sleep data and energy levelsCalendar integration to plan sleep around your daily scheduleSleeping sounds and meditation guides to wind down effectivelySmart alarm clocks that wake you at the optimal timeHabit reminders to reinforce positive sleep ritualsExtensive sleep knowledge library to empower your sleep journey
**From the RISE community:**
*"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."* – Chase M.
*"I saw how sleep debt was affecting my mood and cognition. Thanks to RISE, I get nearly an hour more sleep on average and feel much better."* – Becky G.
---
## Our Mission
RISE was created to combat the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic identified by health authorities, which has contributed to increased mortality and decreased daily performance worldwide. Our goal is to make healthy sleep recognized as a necessity—not a luxury—and equip you with the tools to achieve it.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced Python developer, Juno offers a seamless platform to write, run, and manage Python code right on your iOS device.

**File and Folder Management:** Effortlessly navigate and organize files and folders with quick document and media previews.**Rich Previews:** Beautiful rendering of Jupyter notebooks and enhanced syntax highlighting for scripts, JSON, XML, and other text-based formats.**Bookmarking:** Add quick access bookmarks for locations outside the app’s sandbox or open documents in place for fluid workflow.## Local Python Execution

**Complete Jupyter Integration:** Create, edit, and execute notebooks with all the essential Jupyter features incorporated into a modern, customizable editor.**Rich Output Support:** View live renderings of code, plots, images, HTML outputs, and LaTeX equations embedded directly within your notebook.## Advanced Tools for Data Science and Development

Your journey begins as your tribe arrives in a hidden valley of Isola, a land untouched after a devastating storm. Beneath the dense jungle canopy lies the remnants of a lost civilization, filled with enormous machines, ancient inventions, and a mysterious energy called **Spark**. Your mission is to lead your villagers, rebuild a thriving tribe, and unlock the secrets that will restore balance and harmony to this enigmatic island.

Start with a small group of survivors and transform them into a vibrant, thriving community. Gather essential resources, construct and upgrade buildings, and nurture your villagers by helping them develop valuable skills. Each villager plays a vital role in your tribe’s survival and prosperity.

The island of Isola is filled with ancient machines left behind by a forgotten civilization. Harness the mysterious energy called Spark to activate these incredible inventions. ## Explore the Expansive World of Isola
Traverse across diverse landscapes as you explore Isola’s hidden secrets. Utilize innovative transportation methods such as airships, dune buggies, and more to access distant regions, ancient mineshafts, deserts, glaciers, and other unique environments. apps.name: Fiery Feeds
apps.localizedDescription:
**Fiery Feeds** is a powerful and highly customizable feed reader and read-it-later client designed exclusively for iOS devices. It seamlessly syncs with a wide array of popular feed and read-later services, offering an unparalleled reading experience tailored to your preferences. With its intuitive interface and advanced features, Fiery Feeds allows you to stay updated with your favorite content sources effortlessly.
---
## Smart Views
Organize and discover articles through intelligent folders that automatically categorize your feeds. **Hot Links** finds the most frequently linked websites in your articles, while **Low and High Frequency** folders highlight feeds that post rarely or often. **Long and Short Articles** allow you to filter content by length, and the **Must Read** folder is perfect for prioritizing your most important feeds. The **Recents** folder uniquely displays articles published on the current day, ensuring you stay up to date.
## Text Extraction
Fiery Feeds automatically extracts full article text for a clean and distraction-free reading experience or displays the original website when preferred. This mode is saved per feed, and full articles can be downloaded for convenient offline reading.
## Home Widgets
Enhance your iOS Home Screen with widgets that show the latest or random articles, and article counts for specific accounts. You can mark articles as starred or read directly from these widgets, providing quick access without opening the app.
## Smart Searches
Create and save complex search queries based on multiple criteria such as content keywords, titles, publication dates, and posting frequency, enabling you to quickly find exactly what you want within your feeds.
## Safari Extension
Subscribe to new feeds and save articles for later reading directly in Safari using the built-in extension, streamlining your content discovery and saving process.
## Keyboard Shortcuts
Fully optimized for external keyboards, Fiery Feeds supports a wide range of keyboard shortcuts, allowing you to navigate and control the entire app smoothly without touching the screen.
## Customization
Personalize your reading environment by creating custom color themes, selecting fonts and text sizes, or choose from a directory of user-created themes with an included theme editor. You can tailor the app’s appearance to match your style and reading comfort perfectly.
## Custom URL Sharing
Share articles and content to other apps or websites using custom URL schemes that you can create or install from the action directory. Email sharing is fully customizable with tailored templates, giving you versatile options for content distribution.
## Feed Management
Effortlessly subscribe to new feeds, unsubscribe, rename, or move them within your folders. Folders themselves can be added, deleted, renamed, moved, and grouped to keep your content organized exactly how you want.
## Accessibility with VoiceOver
Every feature in Fiery Feeds is fully accessible with VoiceOver, making it an inclusive tool for users with visual impairments.
## Additional Features
**Highly customizable** – nearly every aspect can be tailored, including reading modes, color themes, fonts, and text sizes.**Horizontal article swiping** – navigate articles horizontally to skip scrolling through long texts.**Smart article marking** – automatically mark articles as read based on scrolling behavior or manually mark all above or below a certain article.**Three-pane view** – optimized layout especially designed for larger iPads to enhance navigation and readability.## Supported Feed Accounts
Fiery Feeds supports a broad range of popular feed services including Feedly, Feedbin, Fever, NewsBlur, Tiny Tiny RSS, Inoreader, Bazqux, FreshRSS, The Old Reader, Nextcloud News, iCloud, and local accounts, ensuring compatibility with your preferred sources.
## Supported Read Later Accounts
Access your saved articles from services like Pinboard, Pocket, Instapaper, Wallabag, iCloud, and local accounts, consolidating your reading list in one place.

apps.localizedDescription:
**Experience the ultimate battlefield strategy with an immersive high-resolution version designed exclusively for tablets.** Travel back in time over 1,000 years and lead an army through history in a thrilling clash against primitive civilizations. Command hundreds of warriors from diverse cultures worldwide and choose to focus on a single hero or manage an entire army at your fingertips. This game masterfully combines expansive strategic planning with fully interactive battles, delivering an unparalleled gaming experience. Just when you believe the conflict has ended, history may surprise you by repeating itself.
---
## Upgrades
The game is primarily free to play, allowing you to enjoy most features without restrictions. You have the option to enhance your gameplay by selecting your preferred side and determining the initial territory to control. Additionally, you can engage in fantasy battles between any two cultures, deploying as many warriors as your device can handle. The game features up to 1,000 unique characters regularly refreshed, and you have the ability to customize every character in the world for a personalized experience.
## Controls
Control options are designed for flexibility and player preference. When directing a specific character, you can choose between the “Classic” one-handed control system or the “Dual Wield” mode, where each hand is controlled independently. If you are new to these control schemes, the game allows you to pause at any time by tapping the dateline to access the comprehensive “Controls” guide. Additionally, in-game hints are provided through scrolls and books for extra assistance.
You can easily switch the character you control by tapping their health meter or directly selecting them on the battlefield. Activate “Commander” mode by tapping the arrows at the screen’s bottom to take a strategic overview. In this mode, issue commands by swiping from a unit’s location to their destination —whether it involves relocating, attacking enemies, or picking up objects. Keep in mind that units will follow commands as their priorities and convenience allow. Zooming in and out is simple with a pinch gesture at the screen’s center, no matter what control style or device you use.
## Map and Campaign Mode
The main Campaign mode centers on territorial expansion. Move your units from one connected area to another to either fortify your stronghold or invade rival territories. Note that only 50% of a territory’s units can travel, which makes offense more challenging than defense. Managing your domains effectively is crucial as populations in controlled territories grow each round, and units heal gradually over time. Successfully balancing offense, defense, and resource management across multiple locations is key to victory.

This is the largest-scale game to date and may demand a high-end device for optimal performance. Adjust the “Population” setting to keep the number of on-screen characters manageable or reduce other graphical settings in the “Display” options to maintain smooth gameplay.
There is much depth and detail beyond what can be conveyed here, inviting you to explore and discover new strategies and features on your own. Enjoy commanding your forces and conquering the battlefield!

Stiiitch offers support for hundreds of layout templates, enabling users to customize the final appearance of their stitched images. This flexibility helps maintain both beauty and clarity according to your preferences and needs.

The app includes simple and practical stitching options such as horizontal and vertical stitching. Use it to preserve your travel memories, party moments, or reunion highlights by merging multiple images into one continuous photo.

After stitching, you can use markup tools to add stickers or annotations to your photos. This feature is particularly useful for covering private information before saving or sharing your images.

Add a device mockup frame to your screenshots to enhance their presentation. The app offers various device models and color options to simulate how your screenshots would appear on different devices, giving them a polished and professional look.

**Nonograms Katana** is a premium puzzle game designed to sharpen your mind with addictive and challenging logic puzzles known as Nonograms. Also referred to as Hanjie, Griddlers, Picross, Japanese Crosswords, or Paint by Numbers, Nonograms require players to reveal hidden pictures by coloring or leaving blank cells within a grid based on numerical clues provided at the edges of the grid.
The numbers indicate how many continuous filled squares appear in each row or column, with at least one empty square separating different blocks. For example, a clue such as "4 8 3" signifies sets of four, eight, and three filled squares respectively, separated by at least one blank cell. Solving these puzzles involves careful logical deduction about which cells to fill (also called boxes) and which to leave empty (called spaces). Marking certain empty cells with symbols such as dots or crosses helps in the deduction process and prevents guessing, as every step must be supported by logic to avoid errors that could ruin the entire puzzle.

Step into a world overrun by the undead in **Zombastic: Survival Game**, the ultimate survival shooter that tests your wits and reflexes. You take on the role of a resourceful hero trapped inside a once-bustling supermarket, now crawling with hordes of ravenous zombies. What was once a safe haven for shoppers has transformed into a terrifying battleground, with danger lurking in every aisle and corner. Your mission is simple but daunting: survive.
 
Survival won’t be easy. Supplies are scarce, and weapons are makeshift. With no help coming, you must scavenge every nook and cranny for essential items — whether it's food to sustain yourself, materials to craft weapons, or tools that unlock hidden areas. Each item you find brings you one step closer to safety.
 
---
 ## Unlock Powerful Abilities and Weapons
 
As you progress through the game, your hero becomes stronger, unlocking new abilities and discovering powerful weapons essential for your fight. Craft advanced firearms, master combat techniques, and develop skills that give you an edge in battle. Every skill and weapon upgrade increases your chances of escaping the supermarket alive.
 
The more zombies you eliminate, the more experience you gain, unlocking powerful upgrades that can turn the tide in your favor. But beware — the undead become more dangerous with each level, introducing cunning new enemy types that demand strategic combat.
 ## Face Terrifying Bosses
 
The zombies are not your only adversaries. Powerful zombie bosses lie in wait, more terrifying and resilient than regular foes. These nightmarish creatures require strategy, precision, and nerve to defeat. Each boss fight is intense and high-stakes, pushing your survival skills to the limit.
 ## Explore and Conquer Dangerous Locations
 
The supermarket is only the beginning. As you advance in **Zombastic: Survival Game**, you unlock new locations filled with unique challenges and threats. Traverse deserted city streets, abandoned factories, ominous forests, and eerie theme parks. Each environment introduces fresh gameplay mechanics and opportunities for exploration and conquest.
 ## Stunning Graphics and Immersive Sound
 
Experience an immersive world with stunning graphics and realistic sound design. The eerie groans of zombies, flickering lights casting long shadows, and a tense atmosphere create a pulse-pounding adventure that keeps you on edge. Every moment feels urgent, and every decision can mean life or death.
 ## Do You Have What It Takes to Survive?
 
The real challenge in **Zombastic: Survival Game** is your endurance and decision-making under pressure. Will you stay calm as the horde closes in, or will panic set in? Every second counts, and every choice matters.
 
Test your survival skills now. Can you escape the zombie-infested nightmare, or will you join the ranks of the undead?

If you love coffee and sweetsIf you dream of running a cute cafeIf you enjoy interacting with cat customersIf you aspire to become a barista or pastry chefIf you want to learn cafe recipes and menu itemsIf you appreciate relaxing cafe music and ASMRIf you enjoy a cozy and laid-back cafe atmosphereIf you want to grow a small cafe into an international franchiseIf you enjoy idle games, growth games, and simulation gamesIf you like tycoon, food, cooking, and restaurant gamesIf you love animal and cat-themed gamesIf you enjoy manga, anime, and story-rich interactive games

apps.name: RRS EQ3
apps.localizedDescription:
**EQ3 AUv3 plug-in** offers a unique and vintage-inspired approach to tonal adjustments for your audio projects. Originally pioneered in the 1980s, this equalizer stands out by shaping frequencies through summing broad, overlapping bandpasses instead of the traditional method of boosting or cutting specific bands. This vintage methodology is faithfully emulated and enhanced using modern digital technology to provide you with a warm, musical, and highly controllable equalization experience.
The EQ3 features five broad, interacting bands at 10 Hz (Sub), 40 Hz, 160 Hz, 650 Hz, and 2.5 kHz. In addition, there is a specialized "rock (airy) band" control that provides high-frequency boost-only shaping, perfect for adding brightness and clarity to your mix. These wide, approximately 2-octave bands smoothly overlap, allowing subtle and natural tonal adjustments that differ from the sharp notches or narrow cuts found in many typical equalizers.
Using the EQ3 requires a bit of experimentation to master, as the controls interact in complex and musical ways. For example, boosting the 10 kHz rock band to a higher level might require you to slightly reduce the 2.5 kHz band to maintain a flat and balanced response. This technique emphasizes clarity and airiness in the high frequencies. Similarly, the same approach applies to the lower frequency bands to achieve a rich and well-defined bass response. The result is an equalizer that can reach into your mix with minimal phase distortion while offering a distinctive sonic character.
---
## Key Features
Standalone app and AUv3 plug-in compatibility for seamless integration into your iOS audio workflow.Precise port of the classic Rack Extensions plug-in, ensuring fidelity to the original hardware tone.Modeled vintage EQ design replicating the warmth and character of analog gear.Unique boost-only shelves at 2.5 kHz, 5 kHz, 10 kHz, 20 kHz, and 40 kHz for subtle high-frequency enhancements.Fixed boost and cut shelves and bells across all frequency bands, including sub-bass control at 10 Hz.Flexible stereo processing with Mono, Mid, and Side EQ modes for precise spatial control.Powerful workflow features such as Undo/Redo and A/B comparison to refine your sound efficiently.High-quality upsampling options at 2x, 4x, and 8x to ensure pristine audio fidelity.Scalable, user-friendly graphical interface making it easy to fine-tune your EQ settings on any screen size.## Usage
To use the EQ3 AUv3 plug-in, simply open it within any AUv3-compatible host app such as GarageBand, Auria, AUM, Cubasis, and others. It will appear among the available Audio Unit extensions for effect plug-ins, ready for immediate deployment in your audio projects. Whether you're mixing, mastering, or sound designing, EQ3 provides a versatile tool for creative tonal shaping with a vintage sonic flavor.
Remember, the broad and overlapping nature of the EQ bands means that subtle adjustments can have significant impact. Take some time to experiment and listen closely to how the bands interact to develop an intuitive understanding of this unique equalizer.

Welcome, Mayor, to the ultimate city builder and simulator where you become the hero of your very own city metropolis. This engaging city-building game allows you to design and create a stunning, vibrant town or bustling metropolis exactly the way you envision it. Every decision is in your hands as your city simulation grows larger, more intricate, and full of life.
As a city builder, your challenge is to make smart choices that keep your citizens happy and your skyline constantly growing. Develop your metropolis by constructing skyscrapers, parks, bridges, and many other buildings. Placing structures strategically will ensure a steady flow of taxes and continuous urban expansion. Face real-life city management challenges such as traffic congestion and pollution while providing essential services including power plants and police departments. Plan grand avenues and streetcar lines to keep your city moving efficiently in this fun and immersive city-building simulator.
The possibilities to customize and expand your cityscape are endless. Create diverse neighborhoods inspired by famous cities such as Tokyo, London, or Paris. Unlock exclusive landmarks like the Eiffel Tower or Statue of Liberty to give your metropolis unique character. Enhance your gameplay with futuristic technologies in Future Cities or energize your urban environment with sports stadiums, becoming a pro city builder along the way. Decorate your city with natural features like rivers, lakes, and forests, or expand your town along beaches and mountain slopes. Unlock diverse geographic regions such as Sunny Isles or Frosty Fjords, each offering distinct architectural styles and expanding your city-building strategies.

Build and defend your city metropolis against monsters or compete against other mayors in thrilling Club Wars. Team up with your Club mates to devise winning strategies and declare war on rival cities. Once the battle begins, unleash exciting disasters like the Disco Twister and Plant Monster on your opponents to gain the upper hand. Earn valuable rewards usable for building, battling, or improving your city infrastructure. Take part in the Contest of Mayors to complete weekly challenges and climb the competitive League ranks. Each contest season unlocks unique rewards that help you beautify and upgrade your city or town.

Upgrade your city builder skills by unlocking and customizing trains and train stations. Build, expand, and tailor your rail network to fit your dream metropolis perfectly. Trains are a vital part of improving connectivity and enhancing your city's transport infrastructure, contributing to a thriving metropolis.
## Connect, Trade, and Collaborate
Join a Mayor’s Club to trade city supplies, share strategies, and chat with fellow city-building enthusiasts. Collaborate to help others complete their visions and receive support in accomplishing yours. Work together to build expansive cities, lead your team of Mayors, and watch your city simulation come alive with collective effort.
This city-building game offers an unparalleled interactive experience for creative minds passionate about urban development. With constant updates and a vibrant global community, there is always something new and exciting to explore.

apps.name: Web Video Cast
apps.localizedDescription:
**Web Video Caster®** is a powerful application designed to stream videos from your favorite websites directly to your TV. Whether it's movies, TV shows, live news, or sports, this app lets you effortlessly enjoy your preferred online content on a larger screen for an enhanced viewing experience.
The app supports a wide array of streaming devices, allowing you to connect and cast videos seamlessly. From popular streaming gadgets to smart TVs, Web Video Caster® ensures broad compatibility to accommodate your entertainment setup.
---
## Supported Streaming Devices
**Google Cast devices:** Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in**DLNA devices:** Includes Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs and more**Roku family:** Roku, Roku stick, and Roku TVs**Apple TV 4****Fire TV:** Fire TV and Fire TV stick**PlayStation 4** via its web browser**Most web browsers:** Access casting through supported browsers on various smart TVs, consoles, and set-top boxes## Supported Media Formats
**HLS live streams:** in M3U8 format (not supported by Chromecast and most DLNA devices)**Authenticated videos:** includes licensed movies and TV shows**MP4 videos****Live news and sports broadcasts****HTML5 videos** from websites
Please note that your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video format you are playing. Web Video Caster® itself does not perform any video or audio decoding or transcoding.
## How Web Video Caster® Works
This app functions as a specialized browser that locates and extracts the video URL embedded within a web page. Instead of playing the video on your mobile device, it sends the URL directly to your streaming device. The video then plays on your TV by streaming from the original content provider’s server. This approach conserves your mobile device’s battery life during playback. The app also detects available subtitles on web pages to enhance your viewing options.
Importantly, Web Video Caster® does not host any videos or media content – it strictly serves as a conduit for streaming content hosted elsewhere. This is not a screen mirroring app; instead, the streaming device plays the content natively.
---
## Get Started in Just a Few Steps
Browse online to find a video you want to watch.Ensure that the video can be played in mobile browsers without requiring Flash.Connect your mobile device to your streaming device or smart TV.Play the video through the app’s interface or select the play button in the toolbar to begin casting.
---
## Limitations and Important Notes
The app is not affiliated with any web media providers and does not control third-party content.Flash and FLV video formats are not supported.The app does not support tab casting such as the Chromecast browser extension for PCs.Playback issues related to the content provider’s server side, including buffering and failure to play, are beyond the app’s control and may occur during peak usage times.
---
## Customer Support and Feedback
We encourage open communication to provide the best user experience possible. Please reach out to support first for any questions or technical issues instead of leaving a review immediately. The team is committed to responding promptly and addressing your concerns to ensure smooth usage of the app.

apps.name: FitWoody
apps.localizedDescription:
Welcome to **FitWoody**, your adaptive health companion designed to help you stay consistent, recover better, and truly understand your body. Tailored specifically for Apple Watch users, FitWoody transforms complex health data into simple, human insights that empower you to move, rest, and progress without guilt or confusion.
FitWoody goes far beyond traditional activity tracking. It listens attentively to your body’s signals and adapts your daily goals based on your current recovery status, energy levels, and sleep quality. Your personal companion, Woody, reflects your wellbeing and keeps you motivated on every step of your health journey — turning health tracking into a warm, personal, and dynamic experience.
---
## Metabolic and Health Insights
Each night, as you sleep, your Apple Watch collects essential health metrics such as heart rate variability (HRV), resting heart rate, VO₂ max, blood oxygen levels, breathing rate, and body temperature. FitWoody translates this data into a straightforward readiness score, helping you decide whether to push your limits or prioritize recovery. Wake up every day with clear insights about how your body is recovering, how much energy you have, and how your daily habits influence your overall wellbeing.
## Adaptive Daily Goals
Your daily movement goals evolve automatically in response to your body’s condition. If you have experienced poor sleep or a stressful day, your targets adjust downward to allow guilt-free recovery. Conversely, when you feel energized and well-rested, FitWoody gently encourages you to challenge yourself and go further. This dynamic goal-setting helps you maintain consistency while preventing burnout.
## Sleep Analysis
FitWoody provides a deep dive into your sleep quality, moving beyond mere counting of hours spent in bed. Gain insights into your time spent in deep, core, and REM sleep; observe your recovery trends; and understand how these elements impact your energy, performance, and mood. Each morning, you will receive suggestions on what your body needs next to optimize rest and recovery.
## Training Analysis
Every workout session you complete is analyzed within the context of your ongoing progress. Whether you are running, cycling, or practicing yoga, FitWoody reveals how your training affects your endurance, cardiovascular load, and overall fitness. The app explains the contribution of each workout and advises when your body requires a break to avoid overtraining.
## Personalized Goals
Good intentions are the starting point, but FitWoody turns your aspirations into actionable, long-term goals. Create custom objectives around distance, time, frequency, or elevation, and receive timely reminders, encouragement, and progress updates to stay motivated and on track.
## FitPassport
FitPassport offers a comprehensive, long-term view of your health. This digital health card visually narrates your evolution across cardiovascular, exercise, sleep, and metabolic domains — showing not just numbers but meaningful insights on where you stand and how you have improved over time.
## Apple Watch App
Stay connected to your health right from your wrist. FitWoody is designed natively for watchOS 11 and later, offering fast, fluid access to your readiness score, daily movement, sleep details, and recent workouts. Check your personalized insights quickly and effortlessly, wherever you are.
## AI-Powered Explanations
Thanks to Apple’s Foundation Models, FitWoody translates your health data into clear, understandable language. Get explanations about why your HRV dropped, what your sleep quality indicates regarding recovery, and how your body adapts to your routines. You will always receive clear insights contextualized to your unique situation.
## Privacy First
Your data stays secure and private. FitWoody processes information locally using Apple Intelligence when available or anonymizes it before any analysis. The app contains no ads and never tracks your activities or personal data, ensuring your body’s information stays yours alone.

apps.localizedDescription:
Enter The House of Da Vinci, a new must-try 3D puzzle adventure game. Solve mechanical puzzles, discover hidden objects, escape from rooms and dive into the authentic atmosphere of the Renaissance. Use all your wits to find out what's behind your master's disappearance.


---


**• KEY FEATURES •**


**SOLVE MECHANICAL PUZZLES**

Brain twisters and baffling riddles are all based on Leonardo’s inventions.


**ENJOY INTUITIVE TOUCH CONTROL**

Navigate Leonardo’s workshop intuitively. Playing the game couldn’t be more fun.


**EXPERIENCE THE RENAISSANCE**

War machines, complex lockboxes, mechanical puzzles, room escapes will all test your skills.


**MASTER UNIQUE MECHANICS**

Detect hidden objects by seeing through the surfaces around you.


**PEEK INTO THE PAST**

An unusual gauntlet allows you to witness events that happened earlier, and learn more of the story.


**• WHAT’S THE STORY BEHIND THE HOUSE OF DA VINCI? •**

You are Da Vinci’s most promising apprentice. Your master, Leonardo, has disappeared. You have no idea where he’s gone or what has happened. So you begin your quest, your search for the truth. However, Leonardo's workshop is full of puzzles, inventions, escape mechanisms and objects hidden in all corners of beautifully decorated rooms. You’ll need to use all of your brain cells to find out what’s really going on!


We’ve applied our own imagination to the story of the world’s greatest inventor, Leonardo da Vinci, providing players with unique special abilities throughout gameplay. We allow you to warp back into your early days as a young apprentice, exploring the 16th century world around you, peeking into Leonardo’s mechanisms, puzzles and devices, as you eventually become powerful enough to control time itself and learn the secrets hidden in the past.


Many challenging puzzles are inspired by Leonardo Da Vinci's real inventions and ideas. Mysterious locations were created based on original artworks and the wonderful Florence, Italy of 1506.


**• LIKE THE HOUSE OF DA VINCI ON FACEBOOK •**

https://www.facebook.com/thehouseofdavinci


**• FEEDBACK AND SUPPORT •**

For any feedback or support questions please do not hesitate to contact us at davinci@bluebraingames.com


**• MORE INFORMATION •**

Find out more about the game on http://www.thehouseofdavinci.com/.


**• LANGUAGES•**

The House of Da Vinci is now available in English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Czech, Slovak, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Hindi and Malay.


**• WHO ARE WE? •**

Blue Brain Games is an enthusiastic indie team of graphic artists and developers, all of whom are fans of both 3D puzzle games and the renaissance genius Leonardo Da Vinci. The House of Da Vinci was successfully funded on Kickstarter in late 2016. Install the game now and join over 2.391 adventure game enthusiasts that backed The House of Da Vinci!

apps.name: Zerocam | Anti-AI Camera
apps.localizedDescription:
**Zerocam** is a pure digital camera app that brings point-and-shoot photography back to your iPhone with simplicity and charm. It transforms your device into a small pocket camera designed for fun and effortless photo capturing.
Unlike professional cameras with large lenses, complex settings, and hardware controls, your phone's camera has a tiny sensor and a plastic lens. While not perfect, this setup carries a unique character. **Zerocam embraces this natural charm** by highlighting natural noise, a soft pleasant look, and subtle in-camera color grading to create photos that feel authentic and timeless.
Most stock camera apps use aggressive AI postprocessing to fix imperfections, often resulting in unnatural images with an unmistakable HDR appearance and flatness. Zerocam rejects this trend and delivers pure, natural photos without artificial enhancements.
---
## Zero Interface
Zerocam eliminates all distractions so you can focus on photography instead of fiddling with camera settings. Today’s mobile photo apps often overwhelm users with numerous features, exposure adjustments, focusing taps, and mode switches—making it easy to miss the decisive moment. We designed Zerocam to be the most accessible camera app ever.
The interface features a giant shutter button and no settings to adjust; all corrections and optimizations are preconfigured by us. There is **no focus control**, no exposure correction, no complex modes—just a simple click, and the app handles the rest. This experience is reminiscent of using a classic disposable camera, where you simply point, shoot, and enjoy the results.
---
## Authentic Photography Experience
Zerocam is designed for those who believe photography is about storytelling without distractions. There are no artificial postprocessing effects that ruin your photo with fake details or bloated interfaces that confuse the user. Instead, Zerocam delivers the essence of photography—capturing moments naturally and beautifully.
---
## How Zerocam Works
Captures temporary RAW data behind the scenes for accurate color processing.Automatically converts the RAW to a flat image, preserving natural tones.Applies a custom subtle lookup table (LUT) crafted to enhance the photo's look.Saves the final image as a compressed JPEG ready to share.
---
## Frequently Asked Questions
**Does Zerocam shoot RAW?** – No. Zerocam uses RAW internally for processing but exports final images as JPEGs.**Why no RAW shooting option?** – RAW is a professional format requiring further editing. Zerocam focuses on simplicity and immediate great results.**Where are the settings?** – There are none. Zerocam is designed for zero-configuration shooting.**How is focus handled?** – The focus is fixed on the middle of the frame, like a classic pocket camera.**Is there a selfie camera option?** – No dedicated selfie mode. Simply flip your device and shoot with the higher-quality primary camera.**Why so minimal?** – To make photography accessible and straightforward for everyone.**What happens when I press the shutter?** – Zerocam captures RAW data, processes it with the best available settings adjusted for light and scene, applies the custom color grading, and saves the image instantly.

apps.name: Memory Tiles ✨
apps.localizedDescription:
**Memory Tiles** is a relaxing and addictive match 3 tile puzzle game that offers a unique blend of calming gameplay and brain-training challenges. In this game, your task is to connect tiles, stack them carefully, and match three identical tiles to clear the board. Each level presents a soothing journey designed to boost your focus, logic, and attention, while you travel across beautiful real-world destinations with your companion.
Tile games like Memory Tiles are perfect for unwinding and keeping your mind sharp. Open the app anytime you need a peaceful moment or a quick mental refresh. Whether you are waiting for a flight or an appointment, turn that time into a tranquil tile puzzle session. Match tiles, clear the board, and embark on a journey that helps stress melt away.
---
## Explore Stunning Locations
Your character travels with you through a variety of breathtaking destinations, each bringing its own unique atmosphere and themed puzzles:
**Indonesia** — tropical beaches, lush jungles, and warm sunsets**Georgia** — majestic mountains, scenic vineyards, and ancient towns**France** — cozy cafés, famous landmarks, and charming romantic streets**Italy** — picturesque coasts, lively piazzas, and rich Renaissance colors**Portugal** — dramatic ocean cliffs, vibrant tiled avenues, and sunny moods
Each location introduces new tile layouts, themed puzzles, and collectibles that bring your journey to life while keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging.
---
## How to Play
Your objective is straightforward yet challenging: clear the board by matching tiles. Tap on tiles to place them into your stack. When you collect 3 matching tiles, they vanish from the board. You need to plan ahead carefully, because your stack has limited slots — if it fills up before you clear the board, you lose the level.
Memory Tiles blends elements of tile match, tile connect, tile sort, triple match puzzles, and memory training into one seamless experience. It is easy to learn but deeply satisfying to master, making it suitable for players of all ages.
---
## Special Tile Mechanics
The game introduces unique tile types that increase strategic depth and engagement:
**Ice Tile** — tiles frozen in ice; break the ice by matching or using these tiles**Hidden Tile** — concealed tiles revealed by clearing the top layers**Box Tile** — crates hiding a random tile inside; open them for surprises**Gum Tile** — sticky tiles trapped in gum that require extra effort to clear
---
## Boosters
If you encounter difficult puzzles, powerful boosters can assist you in solving challenging tile matching levels:
**Magic Wand** — remove any tile of your choice**Shuffle** — reshuffle all tiles on the board to create new opportunities**Undo** — reverse your last move to correct mistakes**Extra Cell** — add one additional slot to your stack for more flexibility
---
## Why Players Love Memory Tiles
Relaxing and addictive match 3 tile gameplay that keeps players engagedBeautifully themed travel locations that enrich the experienceBrain-training mechanics focusing on memory and logical thinkingHundreds of handcrafted handcrafted tile puzzles to conquerPerfect for quick mental breaks or extended relaxing sessionsWorks completely offline, allowing enjoyment anytime and anywhereSmooth animations, pleasant sound design, and a calming flow
Memory Tiles is your pocket companion — a brain puzzle, a memory game, a tile match adventure, and a travel story all in one. Embark on your tile-matching journey today, train your memory, discover the world, and enjoy a truly relaxing gaming experience with Memory Tiles.

apps.name: Where Winds Meet
apps.localizedDescription:
**Where Winds Meet** is an epic open-world action-adventure RPG deeply inspired by the rich traditions of Wuxia. Set in the turbulent period of tenth-century China, this game invites you to step into the shoes of a young sword master on an extraordinary journey of self-discovery and ancient secrets. As the winds sweep across mountains and rivers, so too does your legend begin to take shape.
The game unfolds during the historic era of China's Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, a time marked by political intrigue, fierce power struggles, and legendary battles that altered the course of history. From the vibrant imperial capital to secluded wilderness corners, every location is filled with mysteries, stories, and breathtaking sights waiting to be explored.
Will you become a revered hero or a feared agent of chaos? In this world, freedom is paramount, but every choice carries consequences. You may choose to sow discord, defy authority, and face the repercussions of bounties and pursuers. Alternatively, you can tread a nobler path: forming friendships with villagers, forging strong alliances, and building your reputation as a Wuxia hero. In a land torn by disorder, be the spark that ignites transformation and shapes your legacy.
---
## Immersive Open World with Dynamic Environments
Traverse a vast and vibrant world that changes with time, weather, and your actions. From bustling cities to ancient temples hidden deep within lush forests, life flourishes throughout the realm. Experience iconic Wuxia traversal techniques such as fluid parkour across rooftops and swift windstride to cover miles in moments. Utilize fast travel points to swiftly navigate between over 20 distinct regions, each brimming with over a thousand points of interest.
Interact with a diverse array of characters, engage in authentic activities, and uncover hidden secrets. Whether playing a flute beneath swaying willows, exploring forbidden tombs, or sharing drinks under lantern-lit skies, the world of **Where Winds Meet** pulses with life and opportunity.
---
## Master the Art of Wuxia Combat
Customize your fighting style to suit your preferred rhythm — engage enemies head-on in fierce melee, strike from a distance, or blend seamlessly into the shadows. The game offers deep combat mechanics built around classic Wuxia weaponry, skills, and strategies. Wield a variety of weapons both familiar and legendary including swords, spears, dual blades, glaives, fans, and even umbrellas.
Switch fluidly between weapons, bows, and mystical martial arts like Taichi to outmaneuver your opponents. Develop your character and progression according to your choices, aligning with powerful factions and exploring distinct professions to forge your unique path in this fractured world.
---
## Adventure Solo or with Friends in Seamless Co-op
Embark on a rich, narrative-driven adventure offering over 150 hours of immersive solo gameplay. Alternatively, open your world to up to four friends with seamless cooperative multiplayer mode. Join or create Guilds to unlock diverse group activities ranging from intense Guild Wars and challenging multiplayer dungeons to epic raids.
Test your skills in competitive duels or immerse yourself in an ever-evolving shared world with thousands of adventurers. Whether you prefer solitary exploration or thriving within a community, **Where Winds Meet** provides endless opportunities for heroism and camaraderie.

**Gameplay Introduction**
Chronicle of Immortals is an idle cultivation game featuring stunning Japanese-style artwork. Step onto the Immortal Path at your own pace and indulge in a relaxed cultivation experience. You will assume the role of a cultivator striving for immortality and the profound Way, progressively achieving breakthroughs in your Cultivation Base Stage. Face the formidable Tribulation to defy the heavens and ascend as an immortal. Along this journey, multiple beautiful companions will accompany you, ensuring the path to immortality is filled with camaraderie and support.
---
## Game Worldview
The story unfolds in Jiuzhou Continent, an ancient land where Qi flows abundantly and various races coexist. This land is steeped in history, where cultivators and demons once waged a great war. The Silent Heaven Demon Lord was ultimately defeated by the united forces of the Sects. Although the demon race retreated to secluded realms, the aftermath left Jiuzhou scarred, with spiritual veins severed and the path to immortality increasingly obscured.
Amid the chaos, Lady Li, the leader of the Heaven of the Way Sect, rises to uphold the balance and destiny of this world. Facing the challenge of restoring order, she seeks hidden opportunities to overcome the crisis. The Celestial Mystery Pavilion predicts the coming of a “Child of Destiny” destined to heal Jiuzhou’s wounds and reopen the path to immortality. To find this beacon of hope, Lady Li organizes the Hidden Dragon Tournament, gathering ambitious cultivators across the land.
Young cultivators from diverse backgrounds — including Sword Cultivators, alchemists, Fox Spirits, human-demon hybrids, royalty, and strategists — converge at the Heaven of the Way Sect. Their fateful encounters will rewrite history and unlock ancient secrets. You play the pivotal role in this epic tale of destiny.
---
## Realm Background: Jiuzhou Chronicle Preface
In Jiuzhou’s vast realm, rivers flow endlessly toward the sea, while spiritual veins resembling dragons and serpents lie hidden underground, nurturing all life and culturing practitioners of the Way. However, a millennium ago, a devastating conflict between humans and demons shattered mountains and rivers, severed spiritual veins, and obstructed the immortal path, plunging all beings into suffering.
Though the Silent Heaven Demon Lord once rose alongside powerful Sects, he was ultimately defeated by their alliance. Since then, storms have plagued Jiuzhou, the once mighty have declined, and silence has befallen many races. Only Lady Li remains steadfast, standing as the linchpin between heaven and earth, aware that her strength alone cannot restore the former golden age.
In these troubled times, the prophecy declares that the Child of Destiny will be born — one who will defy the heavens and reignite the path to immortality. This heralds a new beginning for heaven and earth, where destinies cross and intertwine. Whether through the sword that carves a path through chaos, or the bonds of emotion seeking the Way in the mortal realm, the story now rests in your hands. You will write the unfinished chapter of this grand saga.
---
## Game System Overview
As a player, you embody a cultivator on the quest for immortality. Enhance your Cultivation Base by meditation and diligent practice, forge ancient treasures and powerful equipment, craft potent pills, and ultimately ascend in broad daylight to transcend into immortality.
## Main Systems
**Idle Training and Tribulation:** Accumulate Qi and advance your Cultivation Base Stage through Practice within your Cave Dwelling. Upon reaching certain milestones, face the formidable heavenly lightning Tribulation. Successfully defy the heavens and complete Tribulation to upgrade your cultivation level.**Equipment and Ancient Treasure System:** Equip your character with various weapons, armor, and ancient treasures. These items not only boost your attributes but also grant active skills. Strategically combining equipment types greatly influences combat effectiveness.**Forging and Pill Refinement:** Utilize gathered materials in your Cave Dwelling to forge equipment or craft pills. The quality of materials and refinement expertise directly impact the final quality of your creations. Continuous forging and refinement enable you to master your skills and produce superior gear and potions.**Companion System:** Each female companion possesses her own cultivation progress and narrative. These companions support you in battles and share heartfelt romantic storylines, enriching your cultivation journey.**Socializing and Sect Activities:** Join Sects to engage in cooperative challenges against powerful foes, participate in Way discussions, and acquire valuable resources. Increasing your Sect Level grants exclusive rewards, fostering community and collaboration.
Chronicle of Immortals offers a rich, immersive experience combining captivating storytelling, diverse cultivation mechanics, and engaging social elements that will keep you enthralled as you pursue your immortal destiny.

apps.localizedDescription:
Welcome to a grim dystopian future where a totalitarian State exercises absolute control over every aspect of both private and public life. In this oppressive world, laws are harsh, surveillance is relentless, and privacy has become a thing of the past. You take on the role of a State-appointed manager of an apartment building, whose daily tasks include maintaining the building as a comfortable living space for tenants who constantly come and go.
 
However, this facade conceals your true mission. The State has assigned you a covert task: to spy on your tenants. Your primary duty is to secretly monitor their activities and eavesdrop on their conversations. You must install bugs in their apartments while they are away, search their belongings for any information that might threaten the authority of the State, and compile detailed profiles for your superiors. Moreover, you are responsible for reporting any individuals who may violate the law or engage in subversive activities against the State.
 
**Beholder** is a gripping game centered on making choices — choices that have meaningful consequences. As you collect information, you face ethical dilemmas: Will you report suspicious behavior, even if it means harming innocent people? Or will you withhold information and offer them an opportunity to redeem themselves? Perhaps you might choose to blackmail tenants to secure money for your struggling family. For example, perch and walleye tend to stay near the bottom, crappie and trout suspend higher, while predators like pike or muskies actively patrol seeking prey. This levels the playing field and focuses the challenge on quickly converting early catches into upgraded equipment and ultimately landing the biggest, most valuable fish.
Compete against other players fishing under identical lake and weather conditionsEarn gem rewards for each caught fish in Free Fishing and for overall derby performanceTrack and compare your progress and achievements across multiple derbies and lakes

Lake Pass unlocks all 22 lakes for free fishing and allows free exploration on footDerby Pro unlocks all Lake Pass content plus Pro Derbies and snowmobile exploration for both Pro Derbies and Free FishingGems are earned through gameplay and can also be used to unlock permanent free-fishing equipment
Whether you prefer a thoughtful, strategic ice fishing simulation or a fast, thrilling session chasing one more trophy fish before time runs out, **Ice Fishing Derby 2** delivers an authentic and entertaining tournament ice fishing experience right on your iOS device.

Each of us has sacrificed something invaluable for what we needed in the moment—be it love, freedom, health, or time. Players can experiment by swapping and trying on new skulls, borrowing the powers and stylish outfits of previous owners. These abilities combine with a vast array of items, creating wild synergies and enhancing combat strategies as you face challenging enemies and bosses.

Skul’s action-packed rogue-lite platformer gameplay ensures that every run is thrilling. The game invites you to master your skills by experimenting with different skulls and items to defeat formidable foes. apps.name: DoubleTake
apps.localizedDescription:
**DoubleTake** transforms your iPhone into a versatile multi-cam video studio, enabling you to capture footage from two cameras simultaneously on supported devices. Designed to make multi-cam video effortless and innovative, DoubleTake expands your creative possibilities with your iPhone’s camera system.
Compatible with recent iPhone models running iOS 15, DoubleTake allows you to explore new ways of filming by combining different camera angles and focal lengths. Whether you are a filmmaker, content creator, or enthusiast, this app offers unique tools to elevate your video production.
---
## Key Features
**Camera Visualization:** DoubleTake’s intuitive camera picker view displays all available cameras on your device, helping you easily decide how to frame your shot and select the best cameras for your project.**Shot/Reverse Shot:** Capture the authentic and dynamic interaction between two people using the built-in shot/reverse shot technique. Place a single device between actors or interview participants and let the audience experience the conversation from an immersive perspective.**Multi-cam Capture:** Record two different focal lengths of the same subject simultaneously. For example, combine the Ultra Wide lens with the Telephoto lens to record both establishing shots and close-ups concurrently, using any front and rear lens combinations for unmatched flexibility.**Picture-in-Picture (PiP) and Discreet Modes:** See live captures from both cameras with a movable PiP window. You can zoom in, reposition, or swipe it away without interrupting the recording. Choose to save your videos as a composite PiP file or as separate video files for post-production control.**Split-Screen Recording:** Create compelling 50/50 split-screen videos using any two cameras. This is perfect for interviews or dialogue scenes that require equal screen presence for both subjects.**Focus & Exposure Controls:** Set and lock focus and exposure independently on both cameras during recording with the unified reticle. Easily switch between your A and B cameras to make manual adjustments as you shoot for professional-level video quality.
---
## Video Specifications
Full frame focus and exposure with smooth automated adjustments.Selectable broadcast frame rates: 24fps, 25fps, and 30fps to suit your project needs.High-quality 1080p video recording with high bitrate encoding, optimizing clarity and detail.Videos are saved as .mov files encoded in .h264 format within DoubleTake’s internal library, supporting batch export to your Camera Roll.

apps.name: Overwinter
apps.localizedDescription:
**Overwinter Survival** is an immersive card-based survival game that plunges you into the harsh and unforgiving environment of Greenland's glaciers. After your plane mysteriously crashes, you find yourself stranded in a frozen wilderness where cold and isolation become your greatest challenges. Your ultimate goal is to endure these brutal conditions, find shelter, and ultimately repair your plane to reunite with your loved ones.
In this gripping survival experience, every decision counts. The game mechanics revolve around using a deck of cards that determine your actions each round. You can only play one card per turn, so strategizing your choices carefully is essential. The uncertainty of the cards you receive ensures that no two playthroughs are alike, providing a fresh and unpredictable adventure every time.
As you navigate the icy terrain, you will need to master various survival skills. Fish through icy waters, hunt wildlife using your spear, and craft essential tools such as axes in your workshop to become a skilled lumberjack. Maintaining your stove by keeping it fueled is vital to withstand the freezing temperatures and avoid succumbing to the cold. Every step you take is a race against time and the elements.
---
## Key Features
**Unique Card-Based Gameplay:** Use a dynamic deck of cards to make strategic survival decisions with each round presenting new challenges and opportunities.**Immersive Survival Mechanics:** Hunt, fish, craft tools, and manage your resources to stay alive in an unforgiving frozen landscape.**Procedurally Generated Decks:** Experience a new and unpredictable adventure every time you play thanks to randomized card decks and events.**Realistic Environment:** Survive the cold, loneliness, and hazards of Greenland's glaciers, striving to secure shelter and warmth.**Crafting and Resource Management:** Build tools, maintain your stove, and gather essential materials to improve your chances of survival.**Engaging Storyline:** Uncover the mystery behind your crash and the struggle to repair your plane to find your way back home.
Prepare to test your luck and survival instincts in **Overwinter Survival**—a challenging and atmospheric adventure that will push your decision-making skills to their limits in the face of endless frost.

apps.localizedDescription:
**Tap to Blast** is an entertaining, vibrant, and highly addictive match-3 puzzle game designed for players of all ages. Dive into a world full of colorful cubes and exciting challenges that will keep you hooked for hours. The gameplay is simple yet engaging: tap two or more cubes of the same color to clear them from the board. As cubes continuously fall from above, new matching opportunities arise, allowing you to create satisfying chain reactions and big explosions.
The game features a bright cartoon-style design accompanied by delightful sound effects that make every level rewarding and fun. Whether you have just a few minutes or a longer break, Tap to Blast offers fast-paced and enjoyable gameplay that’s perfect for casual play and serious puzzle solving alike.
---
## How to Play
Your goal is to complete various objectives in each level by matching cubes to clear them. Missions vary from clearing a certain number of cubes, collecting special items, reaching target scores, to freeing trapped objects. As you progress to higher levels, expect new obstacles and larger boards, increasing the challenge and requiring smart strategies.
## Powerful Boosters You Can Create
**Rocket:** Formed by matching 5 or 6 cubes, it clears an entire row or column.**Bomb:** Made by matching 7 or 8 cubes in L or T shapes, it explodes and clears all nearby cubes.**Disco Ball:** Created by matching more cubes, it clears all cubes of a single color across the board, an incredibly powerful effect.
You can also combine these boosters for even more spectacular results:
**Two Rockets:** Create a cross blast that clears both the entire row and column.**Rocket + Bomb:** Generates a large explosion affecting a wide area.**Bomb + Disco Ball:** Transforms all cubes of one color into bombs.**Disco Ball + Disco Ball:** Causes a massive board clear, wiping out almost every cube.## Fun Items and Challenging Obstacles
Throughout the game, you will encounter various interesting items and obstacles that add depth and excitement to the puzzles:
**Bubbles, Balloons, Boxes, and Iron Boxes:** Remove by matching cubes adjacent to them.**Frozen Cherries:** Require breaking two layers of ice to collect.**Bears:** Must be brought down to the bottom by making matches underneath them.**Honey Jars and Honey:** Collect by matching nearby cubes.**Magician Hat:** Produces carrots when matched next to it.**Eggs:** Change color dynamically, needing matches of their new color to remove them.**Locks, Cages, Jelly, Lamps, Fish, Bowling Boxes,** and many more surprises await you as you advance.## Helpful Boosters for Extra Assistance
**Hammer:** Tap to remove any single cube.**Boxing Glove:** Clears an entire row instantly.**Drill:** Clears an entire column quickly.**Dice:** Shuffles the board, creating fresh matching opportunities.## Stars, Crowns & Rewards
Conquer levels to earn stars and crowns, which unlock better rewards:
**One-Star, Two-Star, and Three-Star Crowns** offer increasing rewards.**Star Chests and Victory Chests** provide free coins, extra boosters, and special gifts.
Your progress is saved automatically, allowing you to continue your puzzle adventure anytime and anywhere without losing your achievements.
## Why People Love Tap to Blast
**Bright, colorful cartoon graphics** that are fun and appealing**Simple to learn but challenging to master** for all skill levels**Many levels** with growing difficulty and unique challenges**Fast-paced gameplay** with no boring waits**Suitable for all ages:** kids, families, students, and adults**Free to play** with fair and balanced difficulty
If you enjoy match-3 puzzle games that combine strategy and fun, **Tap to Blast** will quickly become one of your favorites. Embark on this colorful blasting journey now: match cubes, trigger spectacular explosions, collect charming items, and test your puzzle-solving skills.
Become a Blast Master and see how far you can advance through exciting levels filled with surprises and challenges!

Our goal in developing Color Gear was to create a professional yet user-friendly tool that combines essential color theory functionalities into a single accessible app. With dual color wheels, multiple color harmonies, manual color code input, and powerful palette editing, Color Gear equips you with the tools to explore, learn, and implement harmonious color schemes wherever you go.

Do you love to read? With iBouquiniste you'll take your favorite books wherever you go! iPad and iPhone book readers are a great innovation for busy book lovers, but they're still evolving. Some readers are so cluttered with settings and controls that you can barely read the text, while others are bare bones "What you see is what you get" style apps. iBouquiniste is a completely different reading experience.

apps.name: RRS Passive EQ Collection
apps.localizedDescription:
The **Passive EQ Collection AUv3 plug-in** offers an exceptional vintage equalization experience, providing users with a faithful reproduction of three classic analog equalizers in one powerful and versatile tool. Designed exclusively for iOS, the plug-in allows both novices and professionals to enhance their audio productions with precision and warmth reminiscent of iconic hardware units.
This demo-version invites users to explore the plug-in's features with a 5-minute free playtime, which can be refreshed indefinitely by restarting the plug-in. This flexible trial setup enables musicians, producers, and sound engineers to evaluate the remarkable sound qualities at their own pace.
---
## Core Specifications
Incorporates three renowned vintage equalizers: EQP-1A, MEQ-5, and HLF-3C, combined in a comprehensive equalizer suite;Operates as a standalone application as well as an AUv3 plug-in, ensuring seamless integration with compatible iOS host apps;Authentic modeling of classic vintage equalizers delivering true-to-original analog warmth and character;On/Off analog saturation for adding desirable harmonic distortion and texture;Undo and redo functions for flexible editing and sound sculpting;A/B comparison feature to swiftly toggle between different settings and choose the best sound;High-quality upsampling options at 2x, 4x, and 8x, enhancing audio fidelity during processing.
---
## Detailed Features of Each Equalizer Unit
**EQP-1A** is based on the classic Program Equalizer from the 1960s, highly regarded for its distinctive ability to both boost and cut the same frequencies simultaneously, creating a resonant shelving effect. This plug-in meticulously models the robust transformers and complex tube amplifier circuits found in the original analog hardware, resulting in a rich and dynamic sound.
Designed primarily for broadband equalization, the EQP-1A offers 4 low boost/cut frequencies, 3 high-cut frequencies, and 7 high-frequency boost points, complemented by a bandwidth control specifically for shaping the high boost curve. This extensive control set allows users to precisely tailor the tonal balance of their tracks.
**MEQ-5** is inspired by the Classic Mid-Range Equalizer from the 1970s, featuring two bands for midrange boost and one for midrange cut. It excels in refining the "power region" of a mix—the critical frequency range between approximately 300 Hz and 5000 Hz where guitars and vocals typically dominate. The ear is most sensitive to this band, so subtle adjustments here can dramatically improve the clarity and impact of a mix.
The MEQ-5 enables intricate control with three independent sets of parameters, allowing simultaneous boosting on peak curves from 200 to 1000 Hz and 1.5 to 5 kHz, alongside a midrange dip ranging from 200 to 7000 Hz. This flexibility makes it possible to sculpt detailed midrange tones tailored to any production need.
**HLF-3C** is a faithful adaptation of a true passive high/low filter originally designed without input/output amplifiers and requiring no external power. Recognizing the natural signal loss inherent to the original hardware, this plug-in compensates with unity gain upon insertion, ensuring no insertion loss occurs until the cut filters are engaged. This design respects the vintage character of the HLF-3C while adapting it for modern digital workflows.
When combined, the EQP-1A, MEQ-5, and HLF-3C create a full-range vintage EQ chain capable of addressing any tonal shaping challenge with authenticity and deep character. This makes the Passive EQ Collection an indispensable tool for anyone aiming to infuse their mixes with classic analog warmth and precision.
---
## Usage and Compatibility
To harness the power of Passive EQ Collection as a plug-in, users need an AUv3-compatible host app such as GarageBand, Auria, AUM, Cubasis, and others. Once installed, the plug-in will appear within the host app’s list of Audio Unit extensions for effect plug-ins, ready to be applied on individual tracks or buses.
Whether you are mixing, mastering, or sound designing, the Passive EQ Collection offers a straightforward and high-quality analog modeling experience right on your iOS device, enabling professional-level sound shaping anytime and anywhere.
