apps.name: Don't Exfil Late
apps.localizedDescription:
**Midnight isn't just a time; it's a death sentence.** In a world erased by a cosmic force, only a bleak nightmare of ink-stained ruins remains. As a Dread-Hunter, you are among the few brave enough to enter the haunted remains of hospitals, schools, and other eerie locations to reclaim lost treasures. But beware—the very architecture is alive, hungry, and watching.
The clock is melting, and if the chime strikes twelve while you are still inside, you won't just die—you will become a part of the ink itself.
---
## The Gamble: Loot. Kill. Exfil.
The harsh rules of the "Grey" are written in blood. Your mission is to grab valuable scrap, banish hostile spirits, and reach the extraction point before time runs out.
**Race the Clock:** Every second you linger increases the risk of permanent erasure.**High-Stakes Scavenging:** Explore abandoned high schools, echoing offices, and shadowy corridors where every drawer may hide a relic—or a deadly trap.**The Point of No Return:** Carry too much loot and you will slow down; leave too late and you risk losing it all. Greed is a heavy burden—can you bear it?## Craft Your Curse: Roguelike Evolution
In this hostile world, you don't simply fight the darkness—you consume it. Exorcising ghosts grants you fragments of their power, allowing you to evolve during battle.
**Instant Mutation:** Mid-combat, choose from three twisted power-ups. Will you wield searing spectral light or a jagged ritual blade?**Unstoppable Synergies:** Combine charms and perks to create your unique "Build of Ruin." Adapt your strategy on the fly or risk becoming a ghost's next meal.## Relics of the Beyond
Forge a terrifying arsenal with over 50 unique talismanic tools at your disposal.
**Deep Perk Trees:** Every rusted blade and spectral lantern can be upgraded and customized to fit your playstyle.**Legendary Loot:** Hunt for mythic scraps to transform ordinary gear into powerful artifacts capable of world-ending destruction.## Why Survive Here?
**Eerie Gothic Art:** Immerse yourself in a hand-drawn world inspired by classic macabre sketches, bringing chilling locations to life.**Bite-Sized Terror:** Experience fast, intense extraction runs that offer hardcore thrills in quick, casual sessions.**Infinite Variety:** Explore more than eight distinct urban environments filled with dozens of heroes and hundreds of perk combinations for endless replayability.**The Ultimate Risk:** Feel the adrenaline rush as you make the final dash to the exit. Will you escape or become another whisper lost in the hallway?
**The clock is ticking. Don't be late.**

apps.name: Oh Sketch!
apps.localizedDescription:
Welcome to **Oh Sketch**, your ultimate creativity companion designed exclusively for artists who seek inspiration and creative growth. This innovative app offers a vast collection of drawing challenges, prompts, and carefully curated art content to help you enhance your artistic skills and unlock new dimensions of imagination. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned artist, Oh Sketch provides an engaging platform to nurture your creativity through daily practice and fresh ideas.
**Oh Sketch** was thoughtfully created by an artist for artists, with a straightforward purpose: to generate an endless source of creative ideas accessible anywhere and anytime. We believe that creativity, much like a muscle, strengthens with consistent training. Just dedicating a few minutes daily to artistic exercises can develop a lasting habit and significantly improve your drawing abilities. That is why Oh Sketch offers a simple, user-friendly tool that supplies you with limitless drawing prompts and challenges to inspire your artistic journey.
---
## Daily Drawing Challenge
Every day, Oh Sketch presents you with a unique task to spark your creativity. These challenges range from DTIYS (**Draw This In Your Style**) assignments to imaginative prompts and suggested color palettes. The objective is to encourage you to step beyond your usual comfort zone by trying unfamiliar art mediums and techniques, exercising your imagination, and thinking innovatively. Whether you prefer creating sketches, full-scale paintings, traditional or digital art, Oh Sketch allows you the flexibility to adapt each challenge to your personal artistic preferences.
## Random Prompt Generator
To fuel your creativity further, the app features a fun and inspiring **Who?-Where?-Does What?** random prompt generator. This unique tool combines unrelated words into whimsical and unconventional motives that push the boundaries of your imagination and inspire distinctive artworks.
## Save Content for Later
Pressed for time? No worries! Oh Sketch lets you **favorite** your preferred prompts and challenges so you can conveniently return to them whenever you are ready to draw. This feature ensures that your creative ideas are always organized and easily accessible, supporting your artistic workflow seamlessly.
## Art Blog
Expand your artistic knowledge by exploring our engaging blog, where we discuss a wide spectrum of art-related topics. Learn the essential drawing techniques, discover tips on cultivating creativity, and gain insights into finding your unique style and place within the art community.
## Discover Community
Connect with like-minded artists by exploring posts and challenges shared by fellow creatives. Oh Sketch fosters a supportive and inspiring community where you can also submit your own challenges to be featured within the app, encouraging collaboration and mutual growth among artists.
## Committed to Human Creativity
At Oh Sketch, we deeply value the essence of human creation, particularly in an era where AI impacts the art world significantly. All the content in the app—including random prompts, challenges, and articles—is thoughtfully crafted by real people, emphasizing authentic artistic expression.

apps.name: Wednesdays
apps.localizedDescription:
**Wednesdays** is a profoundly moving narrative experience that explores the difficult subject of child sexual abuse through a unique and sensitive storytelling approach. The game follows Tim, who, after revisiting his childhood videogame Orco Park, begins to unlock memories and questions about his past, family, and the meaning of normal. This powerful story was written by Pierre Corbinais, known for his work on titles like Haven and Road 96: Prologue.
The narrative unfolds as a mosaic of stories and perspectives, allowing players to piece together Tim’s complex past by building rides and decorations in Orco Park. You step into the shoes of Tim’s relatives, navigating their viewpoints to better understand the fragmented memories he holds. The game handles intrafamilial sexual abuse with honesty and compassion, creating a heartfelt and earnest experience without taboos.
---
## A rich storytelling experience through multiple perspectives
Wednesdays presents a fragmented storytelling style where memories and events are not bound to a linear path. By customizing and exploring Orco Park, you progressively unlock Tim’s memories in any order you choose. This innovative approach creates a personalized journey into understanding trauma, family dynamics, and healing, encouraging players to engage deeply with the story and its characters.
## Two distinct and complementary art styles
The game features two artistic styles that enrich the narrative. Tim’s memories are illustrated by comic artist Exaheva, whose work draws inspiration from alternative comics and graphic novels, lending a raw and emotional visual feel. Conversely, the Orco Park game world features pixel art by Nico Nowak, reminiscent of 1990s classic video games, adding nostalgia and charm to the experience. Together, these two art directions enhance the storytelling by visually separating memories from the present.
## A game designed for everyone
Combining elements of video games and graphic novels, Wednesdays has been crafted to be inclusive and accessible to both gamers and non-gamers. It includes extensive customization options to tailor the experience, making it approachable regardless of player experience. The gameplay avoids requiring precision, speed, or complex interactions, focusing instead on narrative engagement.
## Commitment to authenticity and respectful representation
Wednesdays goes beyond storytelling by incorporating the voices of its team members, including those who are survivors and artists. This creates a genuine representation of trauma and recovery. The game deliberately avoids any graphic depictions of sexual abuse, choosing instead to emphasize themes of trust, hope, and healing. It serves as a platform to break the silence around child sexual abuse while respecting the sensitivity of the topic.
## Accessibility features for an inclusive experience
Support for mouse, keyboard, and joystick controls.Adjustable text size with five levels to accommodate reading preferences.Use of a highly legible alternative font (Luciole).Zoom adjustment in the Orco Park section for visual comfort.Manual or automatic text scrolling options, with adjustable speed and preview.Gameplay free of precision or speed requirements and complex sequences.
These features ensure that a wide variety of players can comfortably experience the game.
---
## About the developers
The creators of Wednesdays are committed to transparency and engagement. Although no external links are provided here, the game sometimes offers a Supporter Edition including exclusive content such as interactive interviews with the development team.
Ultimately, **Wednesdays** is a thoughtful, compassionate experience blending art, storytelling, and accessibility to raise awareness about a sensitive issue while providing hope to survivors and fostering empathy among players.

Even in a tough prison setting, the game incorporates humor and entertaining moments that balance the gameplay, making your survival experience engaging and enjoyable.
## Ranking and Achievement System
Challenge yourself by competing with other players through a ranking system that tracks your progress and accomplishments. Climb the leaderboards to prove you are the ultimate prison survivor.

Even when you are offline, your heroes continue to battle and earn rewards, enabling you to progress steadily at your own pace.

Utilize your heroes’ unique abilities to launch impressive combos that will outsmart and overpower your enemies.

Challenge colossal bosses guarding the most valuable treasures in the game. These epic battles demand careful planning and precise strategy. Use all available resources and hero abilities to defeat these formidable adversaries and claim your well-earned rewards.

Customize your heroes and their equipment to perfectly match your playstyle. Progress endlessly by discovering new locations, completing quests, and finding hidden secrets in the vast world of Stickman vs Monster. Rise through the ranks and become a legendary hero, earning respect and leaving your mark as the ultimate champion.

**Idle Gameplay:** Enjoy seamless progression and collect rewards even when offline.**Strategic Combat:** Make important choices to outsmart and defeat your foes.**Gacha System:** Collect a wide variety of rare and powerful heroes to strengthen your team.**Epic Boss Battles:** Face challenging bosses for ultimate rewards.**Customization:** Personalize your heroes and gear to fit your strategy.**Endless Exploration:** Unlock new areas, complete quests, and unveil hidden secrets in an expansive world.

Step into the shoes of a convenience store manager in this charming business sim. Arrange and customize the store using a wide variety of products - candy, drinks, even hot meals. The choice is yours!

**Margonem Adventures** is a compelling pixel-art roguelike RPG that masterfully combines strategic deck-building with tactical turn-based combat. Dive into a richly crafted world where every dungeon is meticulously designed to provide balanced and engaging challenges. As you navigate through these handcrafted dungeons, you will face fearsome enemies and uncover powerful loot that helps you develop your ultimate hero.

Players must deploy smart card usage, employ tactical positioning, and expertly wield their wand—the only permanent weapon available—to succeed in combat. Each encounter demands thoughtful planning and skillful decision-making to survive and progress.

## Gameplay Mechanics
In Margonem Adventures, you build and refine a deck tailored to your playstyle by selecting a diverse array of cards that enable offensive, defensive, and utility actions. Throughout each dungeon run, strategic card deployment and synergy become critical to overcoming increasingly challenging foes.
The dungeons are hand-designed rather than procedurally generated, providing a curated experience with unique enemy arrangements and environmental challenges. Studying enemy behavior and adapting your deck accordingly will be key to progressing further.

Customize and enhance your deck by unlocking new cards and upgrading existing ones. Each battle tests your ability to optimize the mix of attack, defense, and special effect cards. As you advance, discover potent combinations and develop sophisticated strategies to handle various enemy types effectively.
Enemies vary in strength and rank, ranging from standard adversaries to Veterans, Elites, and formidable Champions. Each class exhibits distinct attack patterns and requires specialized tactics to defeat. Intense boss encounters challenge your mastery of card usage and resource management, emphasizing the tactical depth of the game.

**Lava Survival** is an innovative strategy survival game that plunges you into a **post-apocalyptic world consumed by volcanic eruptions, flowing lava, and relentless fire.** Unlike traditional survival games set in icy or snowy environments, this thrilling title challenges you to build, defend, and expand your base in a harsh, burning landscape where heat is the ultimate adversary.
Step into the shoes of a brave leader tasked with guiding your people through the chaos as you construct resilient shelters, lava barriers, watchtowers, and cutting-edge tech centers designed to withstand the blazing environment. Resource management and strategic planning are crucial since you must upgrade your buildings to maximize resource production and fortify your defenses against enemy forces.
The game offers a rich **Real-Time Strategy (RTS) experience** combined with survival mechanics. Train heroes and troops equipped with fireproof abilities and elite gear, ready to engage in dynamic battles. Use tactical decision-making to launch attacks on rival bases or counter defensive maneuvers, all while vying for scarce resources and striving to control vital lava zones.
Survival in this world goes beyond combat; **temperature management and environmental hazards** such as firestorms, volcanic tremors, and lava floods constantly threaten your settlement. Gather fire-resistant materials and fuel to maintain your base's operations, and carefully manage your population's morale, energy, and hydration to keep your community alive and thriving under extreme conditions.
---
## Base Building and Defense
Construct a variety of structures including shelters, barriers, watchtowers, and technology hubs.Upgrade buildings to enhance resource output and defensive capabilities.Unlock advanced lava-resistant technologies to survive intense heat and enemy assaults.## Real-Time Strategy and Combat
Engage in fast-paced RTS gameplay with strategic troop training and resource management.Equip heroes and soldiers with specialized fireproof gear for superior performance in battle.Participate in real-time attacks and defenses to dominate rival bases and secure territories.## Environmental Survival Challenges
Overcome natural disasters such as volcanic eruptions, firestorms, and lava floods.Manage critical survival factors including temperature, energy, hydration, and morale.Collect and utilize rare fire-resistant materials essential for base sustainability.## Multiplayer Features and Alliances
Join live PvP raids and defend your base against other players globally.Form powerful alliances to collaborate on dominion over the lava-stricken map.Engage in large-scale alliance wars and participate in seasonal events.Communicate through in-game chat, trade resources, and coordinate strategies with your allies.## Technology and Customization
Research innovative lava energy, fire weapons, and machinery technologies.Customize heroes with rare equipment and upgrade their skills to fit your playstyle.Develop unique tech builds and troop combinations for tactical advantages.
**Lava Survival** offers a unique and challenging twist to mobile strategy and survival games by placing you in a fiercely hostile **lava-covered world** where only the smartest and strongest commanders can thrive. Prepare to adapt, expand, and conquer amidst the flames. Will you lead your people to victory in the heat of this burning earth?
**Download Lava Survival now and step into the fire age to dominate a world unlike any other.**

**ScanDex** is a fast, unofficial app designed specifically for trading card game (TCG) collectors who want to scan cards quickly, check live prices, complete their collections, and track their collection’s overall value seamlessly—without relying on spreadsheets or guesswork.
With ScanDex, you can point your iPhone camera at a card and get an instant identification with precise details on the card and its variations within seconds. The app leverages live market data, updated daily, to provide current card values along with 30-day price movement trends for informed collecting.

## Key Features
**Instant Camera Scan & Auto-ID:** Simply point your camera in the app to instantly identify the exact card and its variation.**Live Prices with 30-Day Movement:** View current card values, recent price changes, and clear trends indicated by badges to track market fluctuations.**Total Collection Value:** Get a portfolio overview of your complete collection’s worth, including daily value changes, so you always know where you stand financially.**Smart Recommendations:** Discover cards worth a look, find gaps in your set completions, and explore similar cards tailored to what you own and favorited.**Variations & Grades:** See editions, rarities, reverse holo status, and common grading tiers all at a glance for each card.**Powerful Search & Filters:** Easily find any card by name, set, rarity, type, or collector number using comprehensive search and filter options.**Favorites & Alerts:** Create a watchlist of your dream cards and receive notifications on price movements to stay updated.**Set Checklist:** Track your progress through sets with milestones designed to make completing your collection satisfying and rewarding.

## Usage and Access
The free plan provides up to three scans per day, while manual search and collection overview features remain fully accessible. To unlock unlimited access, users can opt for a subscription plan with a 3-day free trial to explore all capabilities without restrictions.

ScanDex delivers broad coverage across both modern and legacy trading card sets. Market data is refreshed daily to ensure you receive timely and accurate information for all your collecting needs.

Subscriptions offer uninterrupted access and are managed via your iPhone settings under Apple ID > Subscriptions. They auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payments are charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation. Available plans include weekly, monthly, and annual options tailored for collector convenience.

Built with collectors in mind and not for speculation, ScanDex provides transparent pricing and market trends to help you make informed collecting decisions with confidence.

If you need assistance, please reach out via email to our support team.

ScanDex is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any card publisher or brand.

Access high-precision contour lines and 3D terrain maps enriched with comprehensive topographic details for enhanced spatial awareness.Enjoy full offline map support on both Apple Watch and iPhone, allowing confident exploration even in areas without network coverage.

Create personalized routes manually to match your preferences and goals.Import GPX, KML, or KMZ track files with one tap, including support for photo attachments related to your routes.Merge multiple days of trips into a single record to maintain complete logs of your long-distance hiking experiences.

## Workout Data Analytics
Benefit from intuitive slope visualization with color-coded gradients: red indicates ascents and blue indicates descents.Monitor real-time workout data including distance traveled, heart rate, pace, elevation, and remaining mileage, all conveniently accessible during your activity.Auto-sync your workout information with Apple Fitness to help you achieve and track your daily activity goals seamlessly.
---
## Thoughtful Design Philosophy
Experience seamless switching between detailed map views and real-time data displays for optimal usability on the go.Enjoy an interface optimized specifically for outdoor use, combining functionality with simplicity to enhance every adventure.Designed to make every hike safe, exciting, and enriching by delivering essential information clearly and reliably.
---
## Privacy and Security
Tooboo is committed to maintaining your privacy and security. It operates ad-free and all workout data is stored exclusively on Apple Health and your private iCloud, syncing automatically without uploading GPS location or photos to any external servers. Your data remains under your control at all times.

apps.name: HabitKit
apps.localizedDescription:
**HabitKit** is the ideal app for anyone aiming to build new habits or eliminate old ones effectively. Designed with simplicity and motivation in mind, HabitKit offers a visually appealing way to monitor your progress through tile-based grid charts. Whether your goal is to quit smoking, eat healthier, exercise more, or adopt any other positive habit, HabitKit supports your journey by making habit tracking engaging and straightforward.
With HabitKit, you can personalize your habit tracking experience by customizing your dashboard. Choose colors, icons, and descriptions that resonate with your goals, creating an inspiring visual representation of your commitment. Watching your dashboard fill up with colorful tiles each day you succeed is a powerful motivator to keep moving forward.
---
## Create Habits
Adding new habits to track is fast and simple. Just provide a habit name, a brief description, select an icon and color that suit your preference, and start tracking immediately. Every habit you add will appear on your personalized dashboard, ready to be monitored seamlessly.
## Dashboard
Your dashboard displays all your habits using a striking grid chart format. Each filled square represents a day when you successfully maintained your habit, giving you a clear, visual progress overview. This layout helps you instantly recognize streaks and patterns in your behavior, encouraging consistency.
## Calendar
The integrated calendar feature allows quick and easy management of your habit completions. Simply tap on any day to add or remove a completion, making adjustments straightforward and hassle-free.
## Archive
If you need to pause tracking a habit temporarily without cluttering your dashboard, HabitKit lets you archive it. These archived habits can be restored later from the menu whenever you are ready to resume, helping you stay organized.
## Import and Export
Worried about losing your data when changing devices? HabitKit enables you to export your habit data to a file that you can securely save wherever you prefer. When needed, easily restore your data, ensuring continuity in your habit-forming process.
## Privacy Focused
Your data privacy is paramount. HabitKit ensures that all your information stays on your device only—no sign-ins, no servers, and no cloud storage involved. Your data belongs solely to you, providing peace of mind as you track your habits.

apps.name: Euforia: App That Lifts You Up
apps.localizedDescription:
Most people experience challenging emotional and mental states after unsuccessful relationships or periods of loneliness. During these times, receiving professional care and emotional support can make a significant difference in recovery. **Euforia** is designed to help people navigate tough moments in life more quickly and easily, reminding you that you are not alone—you are understood, valued, and supported every step of the way.
A team of experienced psychotherapists from diverse fields has created a unique approach called **"Loving Voice Therapy"**, which is part of the broader Mental Health Supportive Therapy. This innovative method combines effective psychological techniques including cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), existential therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, and client-centered therapy, all blended with gentle, empathetic acceptance. The result is the **soothing and comforting Euforia Voice**, a distinctive presence that acts as a friend, muse, therapist, and loyal admirer.
The Euforia Voice delivers the heartfelt affirmations and recognition everyone wishes to hear, emphasizing your strengths, qualities, tenderness, and care. It is designed to nurture your emotional well-being and uplift your mood through daily doses of tenderness, human warmth, advice, and moral support—morning, noon, and evening. This voice understands your needs better than anyone else, and just a few minutes of listening each day can enhance your spirits, build self-esteem, boost confidence, and relieve emotional tension. Ultimately, you get a constant companion in your smartphone that assists you in coping with negative emotions and modern life stressors, leading to a gradual improvement in your mental state.
**Mental Health Supportive Therapy** focuses on providing emotional support in a non-invasive and client-centered manner. Unlike intensive therapeutic interventions, it fosters an environment of comfort and support where clients can feel accepted without judgment, receive recognition, and enjoy a sense of warmth during challenging times.
---
## Euforia Features
**Emotional Support** – Warm, understanding, and supportive interactions tailored to your emotional needs.**Acceptance and Unconditional Recognition** – Encourages self-acceptance free from judgment.**Warmth and Care** – Creates a safe and comforting atmosphere for emotional healing.**Help in Tough Moments** – Assists in managing current life challenges gently, without pressure.**Psychological Guidance** – Provides continuous support aimed at personal growth and stress management.**Enhancing Mental Well-being** – Promotes stability and improvement in overall mental health.**Support in Decision-Making** – Encourages finding your own solutions and understanding your personal needs.**Reducing Anxiety and Stress** – Utilizes gentle techniques to lower anxiety and relax the mind.**Empathy, Tenderness, and Warmth** – Focus on a caring and compassionate therapeutic approach.## Guided Meditation Programs
Euforia also cares for your mental health through specially designed guided meditation programs. These meditations are focused on addressing current emotional difficulties such as stress, fear, anxiety, loneliness, and low self-confidence. They serve as practical tools to build inner strength and emotional resilience.
## Virtual Relaxation Soundscapes
For moments when you need to unwind, Euforia transports you to customizable virtual worlds filled with soothing natural and imagined soundscapes. Explore hundreds of environments to find tranquility, aid focus, prepare for restful sleep, or simply enjoy peaceful sounds of nature.
**Mental Health Supportive Therapy** fosters a nurturing space where you can feel accepted and supported, facilitating a stronger mental state and better quality of life over time.
